plan.goal: Seed HUVEC endothelial cells at 5e4 cells/cm^2 onto the 0.08 cm^2 culture area of a 400 um x 20 mm channel and determine the cells per channel.
plan.rationale: Seeding count follows from seeding density × culture area. HUVEC seeding density 5e4 cells/cm^2 is within the literature range (1e4-2e4 cells/cm^2 typical, but 5e4 is a defensible higher-density choice for a confluent monolayer). Channel area 0.08 cm^2 corresponds to a 400 um wide × 20 mm long channel.
caveats: Verify the channel culture area is actually 0.08 cm^2 (400 um x 20 mm = 0.08 cm^2, assuming the full channel floor is the growth surface).
HUVEC typical seeding density is 1e4-2e4 cells/cm^2; 5e4 is a higher-density choice — confirm it matches your monolayer target.
Channel height (100 um) is assumed; it does not affect the seeding count but matters for any subsequent shear/perfusion calculations.
